summary: Implementation plan for Mascu-Skeletal Diagnosis: a space-medicine web application featuring a stationary Earth/Milky Way backdrop with an independently floating astronaut showing crimson osteoporotic bone loss, four themed mission navigation modules (00 Sign In, 01 Skeletons of the Crew, 02 Coach AI-Model, 03 Doctors Review), Firebase Authentication and Firestore persistence, and a server-side Gemini AI musculoskeletal coach.
